EC2: Acute coronary syndrome in the past 6 months
EC3: Cardiac arrhythmias (2nd [OR] and 3rd degree heart block or premature ventricular complexes in Lown classes [OR] 4 or 5)

EC9: Patients with leg injury [AND] involving nerve damage
EC11: Patients with significant bleeding disorder [OR] or liver disorder
EC12: Hemoglobin <1.05 g/dl at the time of initiation of therapy
EC13: patients with unilateral [OR] or bilateral nephrectomy
EC14: Planned kidney transplant in the next 4 months
EC16: Oliguria [AND] (urine output less than 400 ml per day)
